question:
(i) State the principle of superposition of electrostatic forces.
(ii) Why is vector addition required to find the net force on a charge due to several charges?

options.A:
(i) Net electrostatic force is the vector sum of individual forces due to all other charges
(ii) Vector addition is required because force has both magnitude and direction
options.B:
(i) Net force is the algebraic sum of all charge magnitudes
(ii) Algebraic addition is enough because force has no direction
options.C:
(i) Only the nearest charge contributes to the force
(ii) Vector addition is needed only for equal charges
options.D:
(i) Each charge changes the magnitude of other individual forces
(ii) Forces should always be multiplied rather than added
